english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for something that has just begun or is only starting to exist.

examples.english: This nascent project is still rough, so give it some time.
examples.traditional: 呢個啱啱開始嘅計劃仲好粗疏，大家畀啲時間佢啦。
